en: The postcard displays a black-and-white photograph of the western façade of the Abbaye de Saint-Denis. The image prominently features three sculpted Romanesque/Gothic portals with elaborate decoration, and a horse-drawn carriage is stopped in front of the building. A person stands nearby on the cobblestone street. The caption at the bottom identifies the location and architectural feature depicted.
